My new Thai dentist!
Gentle, with amazing attention to detail. Would recommend to anyone without hesitation.

I am a regular patient here, regularly seeing Dr. Wannisa. She provides excellent care, both in terms of advice and treatment.

The clinic maintains high standards of hygiene and cleanliness. Social security insurance is accepted. There is parking available in front of the clinic.

My crown came off, so I called the clinic for advice. The staff were very helpful. When I went to see the dentist, they fixed it right away, and the dentist gave me very detailed and clear explanations about the treatment.
The clinic is clean and the doctor is very kind.
Very satisfied Doctor, patient and caring dentist 😘😍😍 …
